Name: DeepWoods Seasonal statue Obelisk
Author: Tolpen
Description:
Four images that change the Deep Woods Obelisk to a statue slightly changing with the passage of seasons. This[s] mod [/s]asset replacement was made for the Deep Woods Obelisk to match with [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7446]Kats Statue Obelisks[/url] who's made it know that they won't update the mod.
As I do not know how to mod in the slightest besides replacing pictures and toying with the config file + a mod replacing the Deep Woods Obelisk seasonally has already been written, this mod uses Sandman53's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5016]DeepWoods Seasonal Obelisk[/url] as it's base and merely replaces the existing image files. I haven't written a single line of code.

[b]INSTALLATION:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download the DWSS.zip file.
[*]If you do not have it already, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5016]DeepWoods Seasonal Obelisk[/url]﻿ as made by Sandman53.
[*]Go to [b][DW]SeasonalObelisk[/b] folder, pen the [b]assets[/b] file and replace the images there with those extracted from DWSS.zip.
[*](Optional, recommended) Do the octopus dance.
[/list]
FEATURES:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/16467/16467-1682584412-1834659593.png[/img]﻿[/center][list]
[*]Four Deep Woods Statue Obelisk stylised as a cute little bear cub.
[*]That's it.
[/list][center]﻿[/center]There should not be any bugs with this image replacement that aren't with DeepWoods Seasonal Obelisk. It is possible that in a future update of that mod the asset images will be renamed, in which case if you rename the Statue Obelisk images accordingly everything should be fine.
